subject: SDLC artifacts and short sample deliverables for Borealis SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Margot Lane <margot@borealiscap.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: intake@borealiscap.com
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDLC artifacts for SOC2 intake – initial Qs

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Borealis is kicking off our SOC2 intake and the assessors want a short set of artifacts showing how you run a secure SDLC for services in scope. To keep the intake small, would you be able to provide: 

- a one-page index mapping controls to artifacts (code review, CI/CD gating, secrets handling, change approvals)
- a redacted example of a PR review showing reviewer comments and merge gate pass/fail
- a brief CI pipeline log snippet demonstrating gated deploy (preferably a failed-then-fixed run)
- confirmation of how secrets are stored and rotated (KMS/HSM details welcome)

We'd like these by EOD Monday if possible. If you need to limit scope we can take a subsample (one service + one pipeline).

Best,
Margot Lane
Security Intake – Borealis Capital

--
Attachments: none in first mail

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margot Lane <margot@borealiscap.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDLC artifacts for SOC2 intake – initial Qs

Hi Margot,

Thanks — we can do that. Quick clarifications so we scope exactly what you need: 

1) Index: we will produce a single CSV (sdlc_artifact_index.csv) mapping your SOC2 control IDs to our artifact names and short descriptions.

2) PR sample: we will provide one redacted pull request from the backend service "runtime-svc" showing reviewer comments, CI status checks, and the signed merge commit.

3) CI log: we can supply a cropped pipeline run that demonstrates a gating failure (flake detection) and the follow-up commit that fixed the test. We will redact IPs and runner hostnames.

4) Secrets: short summary + tech details below. Full KMS logs need an NDA extension — is that acceptable?

-- Secrets summary (short):
- Secrets stored in customer keyring on AWS KMS (multi-region CMK), envelope encryption for all secrets at rest.
- Ephemeral runner tokens (10m TTL) issued by our credential broker, rotated every request; long-lived service principals limited to metadata signing only.
- Role-based access enforced via IAM role assumption; secrets access audited via CloudTrail and aggregated to our SIEM.

If that scope works we'll upload the four artifacts to the Drive link and send a delivery note.

We can meet Monday morning to walk through. Lauren — can you attach the PR PDF and pipeline snippet? Jonas — can you confirm the KMS statement matches recent config?

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margot Lane <margot@borealiscap.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 07:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SDLC artifacts for SOC2 intake – initial Qs

Folks — attaching the artifacts as discussed. Quick notes inline.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Delivery: SDLC artifact sample for Borealis intake
To: Margot Lane <margot@borealiscap.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Margot — delivering the four items to start: 

1) sdlc_artifact_index.csv — mapping of control families to artifact names and short description.
2) sample_pr_review.pdf — redacted PR export (authors: svc-owner@redwoodinference.com), includes reviewer comments and the required security checklist checkbox state.
3) ci_pipeline_snippet.txt — shows a failing unit test step and the subsequent successful run after fix. Hostnames and runner IDs redacted.
4) runner_config.yaml — our ephemeral-runner config (redacted) showing token TTL and OIDC provider details.

If you need a signed KMS audit extract we can open the NDA extension request; otherwise the summary provided by Jonas is typically sufficient for intake.

Best,
Lauren
Senior Engineering Manager

Attachments:
- sdlc_artifact_index.csv (text/csv)
- sample_pr_review.pdf (application/pdf)
- ci_pipeline_snippet.txt (text/plain)
- runner_config.yaml (text/yaml)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margot Lane <margot@borealiscap.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery: SDLC artifact sample for Borealis intake

Hi Margot — following up on Irene and Lauren's delivery. A couple of quick confirmations: 

- The runner_config.yaml shows token_ttl_seconds: 600 and oidc_audience: "redwood-credentials-broker" (redacted).
- KMS configuration: multi-region CMK (alias/rdw-svc-secrets) with automatic rotation enabled; API access restricted to vault-service role.
- Audit trail retention: CloudTrail -> SIEM -> archived S3 (immutable) for 365 days by default, longer by contract.

If you want a short walkthrough I can share my screen Tuesday 09:00 PT and step through the PR and the pipeline snippet; should take ~20 minutes.

Margot — anything else you need for intake right now?

Thanks,
Jonas
Principal DevOps Engineer

Quoted text included above in attachments and the index.
